title: How to Open a PayPal Account in Sri Lanka
summary: Open a PayPal account in Sri Lanka through ComBank or Sampath. Follow the exact signup, bank-linking and withdrawal steps, including the email fix.
body_markdown:
**As of 9 September 2026, you can open and link a personal PayPal account through Commercial Bank or Sampath to receive overseas payments in Sri Lanka.**


Start with your bank’s PayPal connection. It lets you create an account, receive client payments and withdraw to your local bank. At ComBank, the important detail is simple: your email address and date of birth must match on both accounts.


Below are the steps for a new account, an existing account and the first withdrawal.


## Should a freelancer open a personal or business account?


**Open a personal account through the bank.** It can receive overseas goods-and-services payments now. New business signup through banks isn’t live, and neither are invoicing or Checkout. The[PayPal partner page](https://www.paypal.com/lk/business/banking-partners) lists personal signup at ComBank and Sampath.


Use a personal PayPal account for the ComBank route. PayPal’s partner page allows existing business accounts to link to a retail or sole-trader bank account, but[ComBank’s FAQ](https://www.combank.lk/info/215) limits its service to personal PayPal accounts.


See[PayPal in Sri Lanka](https://www.elevatepay.co/blog/paypal-in-sri-lanka) for the bank-by-bank features. Our[general PayPal signup guide](https://www.elevatepay.co/learn/how-to-create-a-paypal-account) covers standard registration; the local-bank steps on this page are what activate receiving in Sri Lanka.


## What do you need to open a PayPal account?


For the[ComBank route](https://www.combank.lk/services/paypal) , you need:


-


To be 18 or older.


-


A personal ComBank savings or current account and the ComBank Digital mobile app.


-


A working mobile number registered with the bank.


-


The same email address and date of birth at ComBank and PayPal.


-


For an existing PayPal account, Sri Lanka registration, completed identity and email verification, and no account restrictions.


Use your real Sri Lankan address and identity. You’ll sign in to PayPal during the connection; you don’t need an account seller or a relative abroad.


ComBank’s standard internet-banking website can’t complete this link. Use its mobile app. Withdrawals go to a personal LKR account.


## Open a new account through Commercial Bank


Open the **ComBank Digital mobile app** , then:


1.


Tap **View all my accounts** .


2.


Find PayPal and tap **Connect** .


3.


Turn on the email-sharing consent and tap **Confirm** .


4.


Enter your registration details and tap **Next** .


5.


Enter the one-time password sent during verification.


6.


Create your PayPal password.


7.


Tap **Agree and Connect** .


A linking confirmation appears, and the connected PayPal balance becomes visible in **My Portfolio** .


PayPal’s shorter overview calls the starting area Portfolio; ComBank’s detailed instructions use View all my accounts. The Connect button opens the same PayPal flow.


## Link an existing Sri Lankan PayPal account


You can connect your existing account without creating another one:


1.


Open **View all my accounts → PayPal → Connect** in ComBank Digital.


2.


Turn on email-sharing consent and tap **Confirm** .


3.


Sign in with your PayPal email address and password.


4.


Tap **Agree and Connect** .


5.


Return to **My Portfolio** to see the connected account and balance.


If the emails differ,[ComBank’s FAQ](https://www.combank.lk/info/215) gives a specific fix: add your bank-registered email as a secondary email in PayPal, then try linking again. Your date of birth must also match.


A foreign-registered PayPal account can’t use this Sri Lanka connection. ComBank requires a Sri Lanka-registered account.


## Open or link through Sampath Bank


[PayPal’s Sampath instructions](https://www.paypal.com/lk/business/banking-partners) include bank verification before you finish the link:


1.


Sign in to Sampath’s bank dashboard and open **PayPal** .


2.


Submit the application to sign up for PayPal or link your existing account.


3.


Receive Sampath’s notification that verification has succeeded.


4.


Return to **PayPal** in the bank dashboard and complete signup or sign in to the account you’re linking.


5.


Use the connected account to receive overseas payments and withdraw.


Sampath’s personal-account service is live. The application stage comes before the PayPal connection, so an application still awaiting verification hasn’t completed setup.


## How do you receive your first PayPal payment?


After connecting your bank, give the overseas client the email address on your PayPal account. At least one local partner must stay linked for this receiving service.


Your client must be outside Sri Lanka. Domestic payments between Sri Lankan PayPal accounts aren’t part of this rollout.


The payment must become available in your PayPal balance before you withdraw. A new payment can be held for review even when the bank link is complete.


Keep the client invoice or contract with the payment reference so you have a record of what the payment covers.


## Withdraw through Commercial Bank


Once the payment is available, open ComBank Digital:


1.


In **My Portfolio** , tap your PayPal account.


2.


Tap **Withdraw** .


3.


Select your LKR account and enter the USD amount.


4.


Accept the terms and tap **Submit** . The confirmation shows the exchange rate and approximate rupee amount.


5.


Enter the OTP to authorize the withdrawal.


6.


Download the cyber receipt.


ComBank’s[PayPal service page](https://www.combank.lk/services/paypal) states: “All fees and charges will be displayed before you confirm the transaction (USD 3.00 + 3% of the transaction Value)”. ComBank says credit is instant after authorization, with a **$3.50 minimum withdrawal** . PayPal’s receiving fee applies separately.


A new $1,000 overseas client payment comes to an estimated **LKR 300,079** using PayPal’s receiving fee, ComBank’s published withdrawal charge and its 9 September 2026 TT buying rate.


The[Sri Lanka PayPal fee guide](https://www.elevatepay.co/blog/paypal-fees-sri-lanka) shows the receiving fee, bank fee, rate and final LKR amount in one table.


## Why linking or receiving can fail


**Connect fails with an email error:** add your bank-registered email as a secondary email in PayPal, then link again. If the error names your date of birth, it must match the bank’s record exactly.


**Your bank or withdrawal account is missing:** Bank of Ceylon is still pending. ComBank withdrawals require a personal LKR account; a business or foreign-currency account is not an eligible destination.


**Your Sampath application has not reached the PayPal sign-in screen:** bank verification comes first. The successful-verification notification unlocks the next step in the bank dashboard.


**Your client cannot send the payment:** the local-bank connection must be complete, the payer must be outside Sri Lanka, and your PayPal account must have no receiving restriction.


**Shopping works but receiving does not:** a linked purchase card enables spending. Complete the PayPal connection inside the partner bank to activate receiving.


## Getting paid by a client who can send USD by bank transfer?


We charge $0 to receive a $1,000 ACH payment and $1.50 to send it to a Sri Lankan bank. Using our 9 September 2026 rate, the estimated payout is LKR 327,748, compared with LKR 300,079 in the PayPal-to-ComBank model.[Open your Elevate Pay account in Sri Lanka](https://www.elevatepay.co/blog/open-elevate-pay-account-sri-lanka) .


Once your earnings arrive, follow our[local-bank transfer steps](https://www.elevatepay.co/learn/elevate-pay-to-local-bank) to move them into LKR. Our[full fee comparison](https://www.elevatepay.co/blog/paypal-fees-sri-lanka) explains the rates and assumptions.


## Frequently asked questions


### Do I need a partner-bank connection to receive?


Yes. PayPal requires at least one connected local partner bank to receive overseas payments through this service.


### Can I link more than one bank?


Yes. PayPal allows multiple partner-bank connections. Connect each bank you want to use for withdrawals.


### Is a Visa or Mastercard enough to activate receiving?


No. A card link is for purchases. Receiving requires the PayPal connection through Commercial Bank or Sampath.


### Can I use Bank of Ceylon now?


Not yet. PayPal’s partner-bank page still listed Bank of Ceylon as coming soon on 9 September 2026.


### How long does ComBank take to approve the PayPal link?


After Agree and Connect, a confirmation appears and your PayPal balance shows in My Portfolio. PayPal identity reviews or account restrictions can delay access.


## How we checked this


These steps follow PayPal’s Sampath instructions and ComBank’s service page and FAQ, reviewed on 9 September 2026.
